title: The Ark of the Covenant
lead: The gold-covered chest made at Sinai to hold the tablets of the covenant, with the atonement lid and two cherubim on top (Exodus 25:10–22). It led Israel through the Jordan, was captured by the Philistines, was brought to Jerusalem by David and placed in Solomon's temple, and then vanished from history. Revelation sees it in God's temple in heaven (Revelation 11:19).
